| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Weights** `estimator` | Huber | Tukey biweight, Huber | Huber's weights shrink the pull of far pixels but never reach 0. Tukey's biweight drops pixels beyond c times the scale. Huber is our choice of default, since it scored higher on the worked example. |
| **Scale** `scale` | 0 | 0 to 100 levels | The scale s that residuals are divided by, about the noise sigma. 0 estimates it from the channel with scikit-image's estimate_sigma. |
| **Radius** `radius` | 2 | 1 to 7 px | The window reaches this far in each direction, so 2 gives a 5 x 5 window. Our choice. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 5 | 1 to 20 | The number of reweighting steps after the median start. Our choice. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
